Historical findings CASEID FILE NOTE
1) Domain context: A records office files incoming paperwork by assigning identifiers, stamping dates, routing to custodians, and indexing entries into ledgers. Routine intake involves form completion, signature capture, and sequential archiving without substantive verification of underlying claims.

2) What occurred: The actor prepared a technical record document for a passenger aircraft airframe. The actor populated the part identification field with the serial number of a non-conforming component and entered a manufacture date field with a date preceding the component's actual production. The actor prepared an airworthiness certificate form and executed a signature block as a licensed maintainer. The actor transmitted the document package via the maintenance management system channel to the registry custodian account, referencing a prior inspection report ID. The actor entered a discrepancy code in the inspection report field marked as resolved without an attached correction order.

3) Materials/access observed: Access to the maintenance management system was exercised through a named maintainer account with supervisor privilege. The actor accessed the parts ledger to copy the format of conforming part entries. The actor obtained the airworthiness certificate form from the controlled forms archive. The actor accessed the prior inspection report to extract the report identifier for cross-reference.

4) Indicators & artifacts: A part serial number appearing in the ledger without a corresponding purchase order or receiving document. An airworthiness certificate signature timestamp preceding the associated inspection report creation timestamp. A maintenance transaction with a part source flagged as "unapproved supplier" in the supplier master file but recorded in the part source field as "OEM." A discrepancy closure entry lacking an attached engineering approval reference. Sequential part history entries with dates that contradict the supplier's shipment records for the same serial number.
